title: Give retirement village inquiry and disclosure documents
what: Give a prospective resident the proposed residence contract, a notice of their rights and the other listed documents before the contract.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.quote: Before a person enters into a residence contract, the operator must give to that person – (a) a copy of the proposed residence contract in a form ready for execution; and (b) a notice of the person's rights under this Act in accordance with Schedule 2 ;

administration.who: Director of Consumer Affairs and Fair Trading (Tas)
